title: Library
body:
***cmath***
pow
```C++
answer = pow(2,3);
```
	-> 8

sqrt and pow in a larger expression
```C++
discrim = sqrt( pow(b,2) - 4 * a * c);
```

[[File]]s

The Python equivalent is [[Standard Library]] in [[INTRODUCTION TO COMPUTER SCIENCE]]: `math`
is `cmath` with the same functions, plus `random` and `turtle`. The difference is packaging, not
content, and here it needs a [[Header File]].
